question: What’s the repayment difference between a Canada Student Grant and a Canada Student Loan?
generated_answer: The Canada Student Grant is non-repayable, while the Canada Student Loan is repayable. You must repay your Canada Student Loan, even if you didn’t complete your studies. You’ll start repaying your loan six months after you leave school, regardless of whether you’re working or not. You can also choose to start repaying your loan earlier. If you’re having trouble repaying your loan, you can apply for repayment assistance. This can help you reduce your monthly payments or even have your loan forgiven. You can apply for repayment assistance through the National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC). The NSLSC is a government agency that helps students manage their student loans. They can provide you with information on repayment assistance, as well as help you apply for it. It’s worth noting that repayment assistance is not available for Canada Student Grants. These grants are non-repayable, so you don’t have to worry about repaying them. However, you may still be required to repay your Canada Student Loan, even if you received a grant. It’s essential to understand the terms and conditions of your student loan and grant, so you can make informed decisions about your financial situation.
